reviewNotes: The complete forty-eight-string movie concession table is translated directly from English. All twenty-four snack names and descriptions use concise Romanian menu language while retaining Joja brands, food-specific texture and each joke, including the artificial `b’utter` label.

BlackLicorice_Description.source: A chewy candy with an intense, pungent flavor.
BlackLicorice_Description.translation: O bomboană elastică, cu o aromă intensă și pătrunzătoare.

CappuccinoMousseCake_Description.source: A small chocolate cake glazed with a cappuccino mousse.
CappuccinoMousseCake_Description.translation: Un tort mic de ciocolată, glazurat cu mousse de cappuccino.

ChocolatePopcorn_Description.source: It's normal popcorn... but with a chocolate coating.
ChocolatePopcorn_Description.translation: Sunt floricele obișnuite... dar acoperite cu ciocolată.

CottonCandy_Description.source: A large pink cloud of spun sugar.
CottonCandy_Description.translation: Un nor mare și roz din zahăr filat.

Fries_Description.source: Thin slices of potato, deep fried and then lightly salted.
Fries_Description.translation: Felii subțiri de cartof, prăjite în baie de ulei și apoi sărate ușor.

IceCreamSandwich_Description.source: Vanilla ice cream sandwiched between two chocolate cookies.
IceCreamSandwich_Description.translation: Înghețată de vanilie între doi biscuiți de ciocolată.

JasmineTea_Description.source: Green tea flavored with aromatic jasmine flowers.
JasmineTea_Description.translation: Ceai verde aromat cu flori parfumate de iasomie.

Jawbreaker_Description.source: It's a big, hard candy that lasts the whole movie!
Jawbreaker_Description.translation: Este o bomboană mare și tare, care ține tot filmul!

JojaCola_Name.preservationReason: Established product or food name retained unchanged in Romanian.

JojaCola_Description.source: An extra-large cup of Joja's flagship soda.
JojaCola_Description.translation: Un pahar foarte mare din băutura carbogazoasă emblematică a companiei Joja.

JojaCorn_Name.preservationReason: Established product or food name retained unchanged in Romanian.

JojaCorn_Description.source: Joja's patented corn food, slathered in plenty of "b'utter sauce".
JojaCorn_Description.translation: Produsul alimentar patentat din porumb al companiei Joja, acoperit din belșug cu „sos de u-nt”.

KaleSmoothie_Description.source: It's loaded with vitamins and fiber.
KaleSmoothie_Description.translation: Este plin de vitamine și fibre.

Nachos_Name.preservationReason: Established product or food name retained unchanged in Romanian.

Nachos_Description.source: Gooey, spicy cheese on top of freshly fried tortilla chips.
Nachos_Description.translation: Brânză moale și picantă peste chipsuri de tortilla proaspăt prăjite.

PanzanellaSalad_Description.source: A summer salad of bread and tomatoes.
PanzanellaSalad_Description.translation: O salată de vară cu pâine și roșii.

PersonalPizza_Description.source: A pizza small enough to enjoy as a snack.
PersonalPizza_Description.translation: O pizza suficient de mică pentru a fi savurată ca gustare.

Popcorn_Description.source: Popped kernels of corn, dusted lightly with salt and drizzled with butter.
Popcorn_Description.translation: Boabe de porumb expandate, presărate ușor cu sare și stropite cu unt.

RockCandy_Description.source: Flavored sugar crystals attached to a convenient stick.
RockCandy_Description.translation: Cristale aromate de zahăr prinse de un băț ușor de ținut.

SalmonBurger_Description.source: A thick slab of salmon on a lightly toasted sesame seed bun.
SalmonBurger_Description.translation: O bucată groasă de somon într-o chiflă cu susan, rumenită ușor.

SourSlimes_Description.source: Tiny gummy slimes of assorted colors. They're sprinkled with an extremely sour powder.
SourSlimes_Description.translation: Slime-uri gumate minuscule, în culori diferite. Sunt presărate cu o pudră extrem de acră.

StarCookie_Description.source: A star-shaped shortbread cookie with rainbow sprinkles.
StarCookie_Description.translation: Un fursec fraged în formă de stea, cu bombonele curcubeu.

StardropSorbet_Description.source: A single drop of stardrop essence transforms this sorbet into an extraordinary treat.
StardropSorbet_Description.translation: O singură picătură de esență din Picătură stelară transformă acest sorbet într-un răsfăț extraordinar.

TrufflePopcorn_Description.source: Heirloom popcorn sprinkled with truffle salt.
TrufflePopcorn_Description.translation: Floricele dintr-un soi tradițional de porumb, presărate cu sare de trufe.
